title: Gham dil pe uthaye
body:
haye zahra haye darbar
<<DIVIDER>>
gham dil pe uthaye binte nabi darbar se wapas jaati hai
lab par hai fughan us bibi ke kaunain ki tu shehzadi hai
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar e sitam mein ahle sitam haste thay meri haalat par
hasnain ke baba se ro kar shehzadi ye farmati hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
haq lene gayi thi jo apna athara baras ki bibi thi
kya uspe jafayein guzri jo baalon pe safedi chaayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar mein us pe kya guzri kya ahle sitam ne zulm kiye
baba ki lehad pe shehzadi sab haal sunaane aayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pehlu pe giraya darwaza mohsin ka diya gham bibi ko
ummat se nabi ki shehzadi ye ajre risalat paati hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai chaak gareban saare nabi aur sher e khuda hai khaak basar
ye kis ka janaza utha hai ye kaisi qayamat aayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaunain ke waali ke ghar se rone ki sadayein aati hai
khaak udti hai har ek taraf har simt udaasi chaayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
<<DIVIDER>>
allah gawahi deta hai jis bibi ki sachayi ki
afsos ghulamon ne ashtar uski hi sanad jhutlayi hai
gham dil pe uthaye...
author: Abbas Jarchvi
